results.title: Minnesota girls flag football state champs to sound the Gjallarhorn
results.description: It's a sport that's exploding in popularity among girls in Minnesota. High school girls flag football started in 2025 with 51 schools. Now, there are 104 teams. In this week's Women in Sports, Susan-Elizabeth Littlefield introduces us to the state champions from Rosemount who are proudly paving the way.

results.title: Vancouver Whitecaps kicking it old school with '80s night at BC Place
results.description: The Vancouver Whitecaps are kicking it old school this week. Wednesday is ’80s night at BC Place, which will see the Whitecaps unveil their Vancouver 86ers-inspired uniforms, against the Houston Dynamo. The blue and yellow Archive Kit features a vibrant Vancouver logo on the front, which is hugged by the Pacific Dogwood flower. If you want to rock the same colours as the Whitecaps this week at BC Place, jerseys, T-shirts and hats will be for sale at the game. The colourful kits are also available for purchase online. And, if you’re among the first 2,000 fans to show up on Wednesday, you’ll get a free headband, modelled below by Hal Johnson and Joanne McLeod. > Keep fit and have fun! Thanks, Joanne and Hal! 💪💙 > > Catch our '80s Match presented by Rio Mare this Wednesday, and get there early! The first 2,000 fans through the gates will receive a special edition 86ers headband 🤩 > 🎟️ |... pic.twitter.com/v5iNOlR5Ct > > — Vancouver Whitecaps FC (@WhitecapsFC) August 17, 2026 Getting to the game early also allows you to visit the beer garden, which opens at 5:30 p.m. Check out the $5 menu at sections 201 and 227, which feature beer, hot dogs, popcorn, and nachos at a low price. First place in the Western Conference is on the line, as the Whitecaps have a two-point lead over second-place Houston. The Whitecaps have an additional BC Place match this weekend, against FC Dallas, another squad currently holding down a playoff spot. That match kicks off at 6:30 p.m., meaning the beer garden will open up at 4:30 p.m. The first 2,000 fans will get a Recycle BC player cup. Fans have shown up for the Whitecaps all season long, and Daily Hive has confirmed that over 20,000 tickets have been sold for each match. Attendance has been strong this season for the Whitecaps, who drew over 40,000 fans to BC Place in their last MLS home match against LAFC. Tickets are available for both matches via the Whitecaps Ticketmaster page. results.title: Frank Junior Adjei scores in Hammarby’s win over Kalmar FF
results.description: Ghanaian midfielder Frank Junior Adjei scored as Hammarby IF produced a convincing 4-0 victory over Kalmar FF in the Swedish Allsvenskan.The result strengthened Hammarby’s position near the top of the table, while Kalmar endured another difficult afternoon at home.Adjei opened the scoring in the 43rd minute, giving Hammarby a deserved advantage before half-time. The midfielder finished a move created by Amin Boudri, placing his effort beyond Kalmar goalkeeper Samuel Brolin. His goal gave the visitors confidence and ensured they entered the interval in control.Hammarby continued to dominate after the restart and quickly extended their lead. Frederik Winther struck in the 48th minute after receiving an assist from Victor Lind, leaving Kalmar with a difficult challenge. Noah Persson added a third six minutes later, again benefiting from Boudri’s creativity.Paulos Abraham completed the scoring in the 61st minute, converting another assist from Lind. Hammarby’s efficient attack and disciplined defending left Kalmar with no route back into the contest.Adjei was substituted in the 74th minute after a productive display. He received a Sofascore rating of 8.1, while Hammarby completed a comfortable away win.
